# TPC-Havoc Q3_v6

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
select
    orderkey,
    total_revenue,
    orderdate,
    shippriority
from (
    select
        l_orderkey as orderkey,
        sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as total_revenue,
        o_orderdate as orderdate,
        o_shippriority as shippriority
    from
        customer,
        orders,
        lineitem
    where
        c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING'
        and c_custkey = o_custkey
        and l_orderkey = o_orderkey
        and o_orderdate < date '1995-03-15'
        and l_shipdate > date '1995-03-15'
    group by
        l_orderkey,
        o_orderdate,
        o_shippriority
) revenue_summary
order by
    total_revenue desc,
    orderdate
```
